lede: The biggest thing on the board this week is Mountain Village Town Council on Thursday, where a resolution setting an appreciation cap on deed-restricted units will determine how well those affordable homes actually stay affordable for the long haul — that's worth showing up for. Ouray County Planning Commission also holds three public hearings Wednesday, including a full repeal of a land-use code section that could reshape how future applications get decided county-wide. Closer to home, HARC digs into the Shandoka Lot redevelopment on Black Bear Road Wednesday evening, and the school district's employee housing proposal gets its first formal look at Telluride P&Z Thursday.
